[EVENT] User is planning to expand their smart home devices collection.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in smart plugs that are compatible with Amazon Echo.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended smart plugs compatible with Amazon Echo:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. TP-Link Smart Plug (HS100/HS105): Popular, affordable, compact design, easy to set up, built-in timer and scheduling feature.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Belkin WeMo Insight Smart Plug: Energy monitoring, scheduling, built-in timer, compact, sleek design.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Amazon Smart Plug: Amazon's own smart plug, easy to set up, compact design.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. iDevices Switch: Built-in night light, energy monitoring, compact, sleek design.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Eufy Smart Plug Mini: Compact, affordable, built-in timer and scheduling feature, energy-efficient, sleek design.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Anker Smart Plug: Budget-friendly, compact design, built-in timer, energy-efficient, sleek design.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Factors to consider before making a decision: Compatibility, range and interference, energy monitoring, scheduling and timers, design and size.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in the energy monitoring feature of smart plugs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Explanation of energy monitoring: Tracks power consumption in real-time, daily/weekly/monthly usage, total energy cost, standby power consumption.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Benefits of energy monitoring: Identify energy-hungry devices, optimize usage, set energy budgets, receive alerts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Smart plugs with energy monitoring features:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Belkin WeMo Insight Smart Plug: Advanced energy monitoring capabilities.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. TP-Link Smart Plug (HS110): Energy monitoring features including real-time usage and cost estimation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. iDevices Switch: Tracks energy usage in real-time, provides usage reports.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Eufy Smart Plug Mini: Basic energy monitoring features.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Amazon Smart Plug and Anker Smart Plug do not have built-in energy monitoring features.
